# Vendored

- `lit-core.min.js`: Lit 3.3.3 core bundle from `github.com/lit/dist` (tag `v3.3.3`, `core/lit-core.min.js`), BSD-3-Clause, Copyright Google LLC. Vendored as ESM so the app needs no build step. `core/test/guards.test.js` pins its SHA-256.
- `pdfjs/pdf.min.js` and `pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.js`: pdf.js 6.4.299, the `build/pdf.min.mjs` and `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs` of the `pdfjs-dist@6.4.299` npm package (tarball SHA-256 `86269b40170eb41740ea05ad2102d71d33de4f122b34eb2f478be0ea7779c415`), unchanged except for the extension, Apache-2.0, Copyright Mozilla Foundation; the licence is `pdfjs/LICENSE`. Vendored as ESM under `.js` so every shell serves them as JavaScript, the worker from the app's own files (issue 374). The fonts, colour profiles, character maps and decoders the package also ships are not vendored: the viewer draws a font a PDF does not carry with the system's own. `core/test/guards.test.js` pins both files' SHA-256.
